notes.title: The Top of The Dream - Sound Track Release
notes.content:
[h2]Sound Track[/h2]

* Main interface theme song
* Stage1-6 & Ex BGM
* Menu BGM

[h3]Write it at the End[/h3]

If you happen to come across this sentence, would you be interested in reading it until the end?

We won't tell you why 《The Top of The Dream》 is still updating three years after its release, how many times our art resources such as portrait paintings and bullet resources have been redrawn, how much time it took to write to achieve our own satisfaction with these music, and how many times the code has been refactored and tested.

I just want to tell you that four years ago, I had a dream. But at that time, I only had one dream and nothing else. In order to pursue my dreams, I started learning game development, from knowing nothing to learning everything, and then to knowing a little bit about everything. My game making skills also went from being ridiculed by people to being admired by a few. But nothing can be so perfect, so fulfilling.

Some people say that when looking up at the moon, one cannot forget the sixpence under their feet. This is a problem that I also have to face. As someone who has just finished my studies, I quickly have to accept reality. It's easier said than done, where should I seek a bite of food? Even if I can endure hunger, how can my team share it with me.

After that, I became a worker. The issues of food and funding may not seem so distant anymore, but the heaviest problems have also emerged. When the game was first released in that year, I was full of confidence and looked forward to what was about to come. I wanted to promote this possibly immature work and let more people know. But the higher the praise, the more obvious the emotions I experience when I fall. I get what I deserve and what I don't deserve, both encouragement and derogatory curses. But what should not be belittled the most is my doujin spirit, which is a dream that I cannot give up no matter what.

“What kind of scene would it be if we lived together in an ideal world”
“The doujin spirit that is not limited by anything is immortal !”

Finally, I kindly request all game enthusiasts, if they have the financial strength, to purchase this album to support me,
Sincere thanks!

notes.title: The Top of The Dream - Comprehensive Update - Ver1.1.0
notes.content:
[i]This is not a dream that can be easily given up[/i]

It has been three years since the release of 《The Top of The Dream》. Thank you all for your understanding and support of this work.
We are well aware of our lack of experience and technical skills, may not be able to produce TouHou-Doujin-STG that are acceptable to everyone.
During this period, we also collected a large amount of feedback from players, conducted multiple tests, and attempted to continuously add and optimize content.
With the establishment of new update milestones, the music production for all Stages has also been successfully completed.
Sorry for not being able to provide players with the gaming experience they should have had when the game was first released,
If you play the game again, you may be notice our efforts.

[i]If this is our first time meeting[/i]

[h2] Music update [/h2]
* Added 15 in-game BGM
* Optimized the performance effect of the audio system

[h3] Art Update [/h3]
* Improved the clarity of in-game textures
* Recreate some visual effects of art resources
* Recreate some character portraits
* Recreate some scenes

[h3] Text adjustment [/h3]
* Adjust the teaching level text
* Optimized character dialogue text

[h3] Level optimization [/h3]
* Difficulty adjustment, redesigned some level bullet screens
* Adjusted and optimized some spellcard difficulty and first-time encounter difficulty
* Added mocking dialogue when encountering spellcards
* Increased the number of enemies, reduced their health and shield time
* Optimized the problem of difficulty in seeing bullet screens in some environments

[h3] New system [/h3]
* Added drop handling system
* Added Differential Convergence (DC) gameplay mode: You can enter the story from any level node on the main interface

[h3] System optimization and adjustment [/h3]
* Adjusted firepower/alertness system
* Adjusted the barrier mechanism
* Optimized the tracking bullet effect
* Adjust Ex unlocking conditions to: clear Stage 6 in any mode
* Function disabled: Hidden functions such as debugging, cheating, and skipping have been disabled

[h3] UI optimization [/h3]
* The game interface has added a numerical display of firepower values
* Adjusted some UI aesthetics and contrast of the game interface
* Adjusted some guidance interfaces in the game interface
* Optimized some text prompt effects and font art in the game interface

[h3] BUG fix [/h3]
* Fixed the issue of semi transparent character portraits during conversations
* Fixed some spellcard abnormal issues


[i]Ver1.1.0[/i]

notes.title: Preview: The Top of The Dream Music Update
notes.content:
[h1]In Game BGM[/h1]
The BGM production project of The Top of The Dream is in progress!
First of all, I am very sorry that for various reasons, we did not provide BGM when the game was launched, which affected everyone's playing experience.
The production of the BGM has begun, and part of it has already been completed.
The production team will continue to share the progress of the music creation, and a series of BGM will be updated into the game until the completion.

[h3]Albums and music packages[/h3]
At the same time, the music package/album of Oriental Dream is also being drafted and will be released in the future.

[h3]Production team[/h3]
The game will gradually update, optimize and fix more experience issues, improve art, and remake some art resources, including sound effects, and more.
In the future, the game will optimize the existing level design, create new levels, and optimize the barrage engine.

Thank you all for your Play, Support and criticism.
The production team will continue to maintain the TouHou doujin spirit, and continue to love the TouHou doujin game and game production.

notes.title: Preview: The Top of The Dream free to play
notes.content:
[h1][b]summary[/b][/h1]
According to the feedback of the players, the finish and quality of the game didn't meet the expectations of the players, but also brought a bad game experience to many people,
So we decided to make the game free to play.
Here are the heartfelt thanks to the players who have given this feedback to the game.
We will listen to each of your opinions, continue the optimization of the game, give all the players a better game experience!
Will be updated in the week after the announcement (not to exclude the delay of the for special reasons).

[h3]Price adjustment[/h3]
The price of the game has been changed to free forever!
[h3]Game difficulty adjustment[/h3]
Will reduce the difficulty of each level and initial kill!
[h3]UI Optimize and update[/h3]
Adjust the part of the UI that directly affects the player's experience!

[h3]Subsequent updates[/h3]
We will beautify the UI more and start making and updating the music from 1 to 6 sides, as well as optimizing for the bullet screen design step by step.
